_note: Billboard placement rules + economics for the billboard-suggestion engine. Researched July 2026 (Serbian Zakon o putevima + Serbian outdoor-advertising price lists). ME/MK laws follow the same Yugoslav-tradition road law — VERIFY locally before building anything.

RS.motorway_mainline: PROHIBITED — no billboards along motorways or their protective zone (60 m), except at rest areas with road-manager approval.
RS.state_road: Allowed at min 7 m from the road edge, WITH approval from the road manager (Putevi Srbije for state roads, municipality for local).
RS.municipal_road: Allowed at min 5 m from the road edge with municipal approval.

ME.motorway_mainline: Assume prohibited in the protective zone as in RS — Montenegrin Zakon o putevima (putevi.me) has analogous protective-zone rules. VERIFY with Uprava za saobraćaj before investing.
ME.state_road: Allowed near magistral/regional roads with road-manager approval and setback — verify exact meters locally.

MK.motorway_mainline: Assume prohibited in the protective zone as in RS. VERIFY with JPDP (roads.org.mk).
MK.state_road: Road-manager approval required; verify setback meters locally.

strategy: New motorways ban mainline billboards but CREATE high-traffic feeder roads: every interchange pushes traffic onto the connecting state/local roads. Best plays: (1) land on the access/feeder road within ~1 km of a future interchange (connection point), (2) land fronting existing state roads that the new corridor will feed, (3) town-approach arterials near new exits. Buy/lease BEFORE the road opens, erect after approval.

setup_cost_eur.note: Steel column + panel + foundation, Serbian market 2026. Add ~€300-800/yr for permits/fees/maintenance and lighting power if lit.

interchange_feeder_or_town_entry.note: Busy town-entry arterial / interchange feeder; city premium spots go higher (Belgrade from ~€340/mo equivalent).

state_road_transit.note: Real example: 60 m2 board on the motorway approach near Aleksinac rents at €170/mo; 28 m2 boards ~€50/face.

rural_low_traffic.note: Only worth it if double-faced and near a junction.

land_lease_alternative_eur_month.note: If you lease the SPOT to an outdoor-advertising company instead of operating it yourself — zero effort, lower income.

scoring.note: Suitability = distance to road/connection point + road class + legality. Lands near CONNECTION points of motorways score high (feeder traffic); lands directly fronting non-motorway new roads score highest; motorway mainline frontage without a connection nearby scores zero for billboards (legal ban).
